name: Hepatocyte
failures: Steatosis, fibrosis to cirrhosis, metabolic enzyme deficiency, drug injury. The liver regrows mass readily but scars irreversibly.

see.note: Biopsy, elastography and serum enzymes are routine clinical practice.

model.note: Regeneration is well characterised; the healthy set-point for a diseased liver is less clear.

reach.note: The solved delivery problem. Lipid nanoparticles land in liver by default — patisiran approved 2018.

edit.note: In vivo CRISPR: NTLA-2001 for ATTR amyloidosis; base editing for PCSK9 in trials.

verify.note: Circulating protein levels give a direct, repeatable readout.
